To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the solder joints realized by using the silver conductive glue are suitable to be applied on the medical ultrasound transducers, in particular for those ones that are submitted to thermal stresses.
the silver conductive adhesive is a suitable material to be used as soldering agent in electronic devices.
the solder joint resistance increases with temperature, but the increase rate decreases with the thickness of the silver conductive adhesive layer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new Pb-free electronic solder joints for the realization of high frequency ultrasound medical devices.
the development of new Pb-free electronic components and equipments for medical ultrasound transducers.
the evaluation of the performances of Pb-free solder joints in order to verify their reliability in terms of electrical resistance, morphological and micro-chemical characteristics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the silver conductive adhesive joints, in terms both of soldering process and of thermal stress behaviour, are suitable for the considered application.
the silver conductive adhesive joints are able to resist to thermal stresses, in terms of electrical resistance, but not to thermal shocks.

the soldering process is not influenced by the thickness of the conductive adhesive, but by the temperature of polymerization, and the solder joints are able to resist the thermal stress, in terms of electrical resistance, up to 150 °C.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the solder joint with the conductive adhesive is a valid alternative to the conventional one, with respect to both the soldering process and the performances of the final product.
the soldering process is influenced by both thickness of the conductive soldering glue and temperature of polymerization.
the silver conductive adhesive is a suitable alternative to the traditional soldering processes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the solder joints are reliable, in terms of electrical resistance, and that the micro-chemical analyses confirm the presence of the silver conductive glue in all the joints.
the soldering process, using silver conductive adhesive, allows the realization of solder joints with performances similar to the traditional Pb-based ones.
silver conductive adhesive joints are able to guarantee a reliable electrical connection between piezoelectric substrate and printed circuit.
